svg.text: Dot above or below a note = staccato (short and bouncy), section C is smooth • Whole note = 4 counts • half = 2 • quarter = 1 • two eighths = 1 count • ♯ = play the black key to the right • mp = medium soft, mf = medium loud, f = loud, ff = very loud
